title: refactor: config-documented, code-implemented field references across all medallion layers
body: ## Summary Refactors the pipeline from config-driven (runtime config reading determines field selection) to **config-documented, code-implemented** (explicit field references in code; MD/JSON remain as documentation contracts). **What changed per layer:** - **Bronze** (`ingestion/*.py`): Each reader now explicitly selects only its declared canonical columns via `EXTRACT_COLUMNS` + `df.select(...)` after renaming. Undeclared source columns are dropped. - **Silver** (`transforms/*.py`): Each transformer declares a `*_FIELD_TYPES` dict mapping every canonical field to its Spark type and applies explicit `cast()` calls. An `*_OUTPUT_COLUMNS` list gates what survives into the silver table. Example: ```python SECURITY_FIELD_TYPES = {"coupon_rate": "decimal(8,5)", "maturity_date": "date", ...} ``` - **Gold** (`medallion/gold.py`): `POSITIONS_GOLD_COLUMNS`, `SECURITY_GOLD_COLUMNS`, `RISK_GOLD_COLUMNS` explicitly enumerate every column included from each domain. The join selects only these columns — no `SELECT *`. **Unchanged:** - `schema_evolution.py` — stays config-driven (reads canonical JSON for DDL safety net) - Config files (`config/domains/*.md`, `config/mappings/*.json`) — untouched, remain as documentation **Post-refactor field-addition workflow** now touches 5 files: domain MD + canonical JSON + reader + transformer + gold column list. All 38 unit tests pass. Lint (`ruff`) and typecheck (`mypy`) clean. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/62ba8b92e7ad451ea5926ea01bd276be Requested by: @jennamansueto ---
